ideas.name: opening drive
ideas.why: the first 15 minutes carry the overnight order imbalance; institutions working orders keep pushing that way

ideas.name: failed OR30 breakout
ideas.why: a break of the 30-minute range that falls back inside traps breakout traders, whose stops fuel the reversal

ideas.name: failed overnight-range breakout
ideas.why: same trap at the overnight high/low, the most watched levels at the open

ideas.name: volume climax at session extreme
ideas.why: capitulation: a burst of volume making a new session high/low exhausts the side that is chasing

ideas.name: absorption bar
ideas.why: heavy volume with a tiny range means passive orders absorbed the aggressor; price then moves away from the aggressor

ideas.name: range expansion bar
ideas.why: a bar twice the usual range on heavy volume is new information arriving; it continues

ideas.name: long rejection wick
ideas.why: a long wick at the bar's end shows price refused there; trapped late orders unwind the other way

ideas.name: five bars one way
ideas.why: short-term overextension at 1 minute; known minute-level reversal

ideas.name: stretch from 1m EMA21
ideas.why: price far from its short average reverts as liquidity providers lean against the move

ideas.name: order-flow proxy
ideas.why: 10 minutes of volume concentrated in up (or down) bars is persistent buying (selling) that continues

ideas.name: gap toward settlement
ideas.why: an RTH open away from the prior settlement is partly overnight noise that the cash session corrects

ideas.name: 15m box flip
ideas.why: a slower box flip is a bigger, slower trend change that should run further

ideas.name: IB break after 10:30
ideas.why: a break of the first hour's range is the day's range extension; trend days start there

ideas.name: lunch-lull breakout
ideas.why: a range that compresses over lunch releases with the afternoon session's flow

ideas.name: flip1 with heavy volume
ideas.why: a flip on above-normal participation is real money changing sides, not drift

ideas.name: flip1 with 15m box agreeing
ideas.why: flips with the slower trend fight no one

ideas.name: flip1 in the first 90 minutes
ideas.why: the morning has the most informed flow; flips then carry

ideas.name: flip1 with 5m ATR rising
ideas.why: expanding volatility means a move is underway; flips in compression are noise

ideas.name: flip1 with order flow agreeing
ideas.why: a flip backed by volume on the same side is supported

ideas.name: potM1 at session extreme
ideas.why: momentum easing right at the day's high/low is where reversals start

ideas.name: potM1 after a long move
ideas.why: easing after a stretched move (2 x 5m ATR in 30 min) has more to give back

ideas.name: potE1 with volume fading
ideas.why: a fading move on falling volume is running out of buyers (sellers)

ideas.name: lead with 15m short side
ideas.why: the lead short sells a failed bounce; with the 15m trend also down the bounce is weaker

ideas.name: lead below VWAP
ideas.why: a failed bounce under VWAP: the session's average buyer is losing
